check_proxy: bad address.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: scheme must be socks5://, https:// or http://

check_proxy: id and proxy.public_message: invalid parameters: give either id or proxy, not both

check_proxy: locked, address not listed.public_message: invalid parameters: the proxies are locked on the host (DEADHOP_PROXY_LOCKED); only the listed ones can be tested

check_proxy: no relay goes through it.public_message: invalid parameters: no relay goes through this proxy yet: point a rule, a group or the default route at it

check_proxy: unknown id.public_message: invalid parameters: there is no proxy with that id

get_relay_history: bad window.public_message: invalid parameters: window must be 15m, 1h, 12h, 1d or 1w

resolve_i2p_name: bad name.public_message: invalid parameters: the name must be a lowercase .i2p name (not a .b32.i2p address) of at most 100 characters

resolve_i2p_name: locked.public_message: invalid parameters: the proxies are locked on the host (DEADHOP_PROXY_LOCKED), so I2P names cannot be looked up

resolve_i2p_name: no I2P router.public_message: invalid parameters: there is no I2P router proxy: add the router's http:// proxy as an I2P proxy first

resolve_i2p_name: no registries.public_message: invalid parameters: there are no I2P name registries, so lookups are off

update_settings: bad registry.public_message: invalid parameters: I2P registry 'http://example.com/?q={name}' must name a lowercase .i2p host with no port or user name

update_settings: i2p proxy not http.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: an I2P router proxy must be its http:// proxy

update_settings: no relays.public_message: invalid parameters: no relay is assigned to the public invoices key, which could then not be reached

update_settings: proxy address twice.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: the same address is listed twice

update_settings: proxy bad scheme.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: scheme must be socks5://, https:// or http://

update_settings: proxy empty address.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: must be a short url without spaces

update_settings: proxy id twice.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: the same id is used twice

update_settings: proxy name too long.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy name must be at most 60 visible characters

update_settings: registry twice.public_message: invalid parameters: I2P registry: listed twice

update_settings: relay name for an unlis.public_message: invalid parameters: relay_names: 'wss://' is not a listed relay

update_settings: relay not ws.public_message: invalid parameters: relay 'https://relay.example' must be a ws:// or wss:// url

update_settings: relay with a password.public_message: invalid parameters: relay 'wss://user:pw@relay.example' must not contain a user name or password

update_settings: relay with spaces.public_message: invalid parameters: relay urls must be short and contain no spaces

update_settings: rotate interval out of.public_message: invalid parameters: group 'g': rotate_secs must be between 60 and 604800

update_settings: rule names no proxy.public_message: invalid parameters: rule 1 points at a proxy that is not in the list; change the rule first

update_settings: rule pattern empty.public_message: invalid parameters: rule 1: a pattern is empty

update_settings: too many registries.public_message: invalid parameters: at most 4 I2P name registries

update_settings: too many relays.public_message: invalid parameters: between 1 and 8 relays are required

update_settings: two i2p proxies.public_message: invalid parameters: proxy: at most one I2P router proxy
